in_marathi.name: Neerada
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Swift as water
in_marathi.long_meaning: Neerada हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Derived from the Sanskrit word नीरद (nīrada), meaning swift as water. In Hindu mythology, Neerada was the name of a celestial musician who played the veena (a traditional Indian string instrument) and was the charioteer of Lord Indra. He was also believed to be a sage and a poet.
